panels.description: 초기 컨텍스트 = 세션 첫 API 요청의 프롬프트 크기(입력+캐시 읽기+캐시 쓰기). 시스템 프롬프트·도구 정의·메모리 파일·스킬 목록을 합친 고정 부담의 근사값이다. 최대 컨텍스트 = 세션 중 가장 컸던 요청의 프롬프트 크기. session_name·project 는 Stop 훅(session-name-hook.sh)이 기록한 값이라 첫 턴이 끝나기 전에는 비어 있다. session_id 를 누르면 아래 표들이 그 세션으로 좁혀진다.

panels.description: api_request 이벤트의 skill_name 기준. 스킬이 활성화된 뒤의 요청에 계속 붙으므로 MCP 표와 겹칠 수 있다(합산 금지).

panels.title: MCP 서버·도구별 귀속 사용량

targets.expr: sum by (mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | mcp_server_name!="" | keep mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name [$__range]))

sum by (mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | mcp_server_name!="" | keep mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, input_tokens | unwrap input_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | mcp_server_name!="" | keep mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, output_tokens | unwrap output_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | mcp_server_name!="" | keep mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, cache_read_tokens | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | mcp_server_name!="" | keep mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, cache_creation_tokens | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | mcp_server_name!="" | keep mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, cost_usd | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.description: api_request 이벤트의 mcp_server_name / mcp_tool_name 기준. MCP 도구 결과를 처리한 요청의 토큰이다.

panels.title: 서브에이전트별 사용량

targets.expr: sum by (agent_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="subagent_completed" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | label_format agent_name=`{{ .agent_type }}` | keep agent_name [$__range]))

sum by (agent_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="subagent_completed" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | label_format agent_name=`{{ .agent_type }}` | keep agent_name, total_tool_uses | unwrap total_tool_uses [$__range]))

sum by (agent_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="subagent_completed" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | label_format agent_name=`{{ .agent_type }}` | keep agent_name, duration_ms | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))
sum by (agent_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | agent_name!="" | keep agent_name [$__range]))

sum by (agent_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | agent_name!="" | keep agent_name, input_tokens | unwrap input_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (agent_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | agent_name!="" | keep agent_name, output_tokens | unwrap output_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (agent_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | agent_name!="" | keep agent_name, cache_read_tokens | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (agent_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | agent_name!="" | keep agent_name, cache_creation_tokens | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))
sum by (agent_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | agent_name!="" | keep agent_name, cost_usd | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

panels.description: api_request 이벤트의 agent_name 기준(서브에이전트가 보낸 요청만). 서브에이전트 요청은 부모 세션의 session_id·prompt_id 를 그대로 쓰므로 위 세션별·턴별 합계에 이미 포함되어 있다. 실행·도구 호출·소요는 subagent_completed 이벤트 기준이다.

panels.title: 도구별 호출 수와 입출력 크기

targets.expr: sum by (tool) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | label_format tool=`{{ if eq .tool_name "mcp_tool" }}mcp:{{ regexReplaceAll ".*mcp_server_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*mcp_tool_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*" .tool_parameters "${1}/${2}" }}{{ else if eq .tool_name "Skill" }}Skill:{{ regexReplaceAll ".*skill_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*" .tool_parameters "${1}" }}{{ else }}{{ .tool_name }}{{ end }}` | keep tool [$__range]))

sum by (tool) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | label_format tool=`{{ if eq .tool_name "mcp_tool" }}mcp:{{ regexReplaceAll ".*mcp_server_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*mcp_tool_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*" .tool_parameters "${1}/${2}" }}{{ else if eq .tool_name "Skill" }}Skill:{{ regexReplaceAll ".*skill_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*" .tool_parameters "${1}" }}{{ else }}{{ .tool_name }}{{ end }}` | success="false" | keep tool [$__range]))

sum by (tool) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | label_format tool=`{{ if eq .tool_name "mcp_tool" }}mcp:{{ regexReplaceAll ".*mcp_server_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*mcp_tool_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*" .tool_parameters "${1}/${2}" }}{{ else if eq .tool_name "Skill" }}Skill:{{ regexReplaceAll ".*skill_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*" .tool_parameters "${1}" }}{{ else }}{{ .tool_name }}{{ end }}` | keep tool, tool_input_size_bytes | unwrap tool_input_size_bytes [$__range]))

sum by (tool) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | label_format tool=`{{ if eq .tool_name "mcp_tool" }}mcp:{{ regexReplaceAll ".*mcp_server_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*mcp_tool_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*" .tool_parameters "${1}/${2}" }}{{ else if eq .tool_name "Skill" }}Skill:{{ regexReplaceAll ".*skill_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*" .tool_parameters "${1}" }}{{ else }}{{ .tool_name }}{{ end }}` | keep tool, tool_result_size_bytes | unwrap tool_result_size_bytes [$__range]))

sum by (tool) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | label_format tool=`{{ if eq .tool_name "mcp_tool" }}mcp:{{ regexReplaceAll ".*mcp_server_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*mcp_tool_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*" .tool_parameters "${1}/${2}" }}{{ else if eq .tool_name "Skill" }}Skill:{{ regexReplaceAll ".*skill_name\":\"([^\"]+)\".*" .tool_parameters "${1}" }}{{ else }}{{ .tool_name }}{{ end }}` | keep tool, duration_ms | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

panels.description: tool_result 이벤트 기준. 결과 bytes 가 클수록 이후 요청의 입력 토큰을 많이 차지한다. 토큰 수 자체는 도구 단위로 제공되지 않는다.

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | session_id=~"${session}.*" | line_format "{{.model}}  in={{.input_tokens}} out={{.output_tokens}} cache_read={{.cache_read_tokens}} cache_write={{.cache_creation_tokens}} cost=${{.cost_usd}} {{.duration_ms}}ms  agent={{.agent_name}} skill={{.skill_name}} mcp={{.mcp_server_name}}/{{.mcp_tool_name}}  session={{.session_id}} prompt={{.prompt_id}}"
